summary: The registrant (Axia Energia S.A.) filed a Form 6-K reporting board resolutions (DEL-099/2026) approving an 11th issue of simple, non-convertible, unsecured debentures in a single series. The public distribution will be under an automatic registration procedure, targeting professional investors only, with a firm placement guarantee. No price, premium, stake, or special-situation event like M&A, activist campaign, or restructuring is involved. The filing is a routine financing announcement and therefore not a special situation.
